'''Annihilator T4-1D''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Annihilator T4-1D appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Cartel companion available from Revenge Alliance Pack, added with Patch 4.5.
